title: Second ability "Disempower this, [1], [Exhaust]: Play a 3 [Might] Mech unit token to your base" cannot be activated
expected: Reproduced: running parseAbilities on Hextech Disc's rulesText yields abilities[1] = {type:"spell", timing:"action", effect:create-token Mech} with no cost. Root cause: packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/activated.ts:205-207 — the leading-text-cost regex only accepts "Disempower me" (`/^(Discard ...|Disempower me)((?:,\s*:rb_...:)*):\s*(.+)$/`), so "Disempower this, [1], [Exhaust]: ..." fails every activated-ability pattern, parseActivatedAbility returns undefined, and parseOtherSegment (other-segment.ts:30-39/66-69) falls through to a costless spell ability. The engine gates activation on ability.type === "activated" (riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/chain/activate-ability.ts:104,145,340), so no activateAbility move is enumerated and forcing it fails. Checked-in ven.json:2715 also has abilities:[null] for this card.
observed: No activateAbility move listed for the Disc in that state (turn 3: empowered=true, exhausted=false, energy 5). Forcing activateAbility abilityIndex:1 via REST returns CONDITION_FAILED. Runtime card def (/api/cards/ven-087-166) shows abilities[1] = {type:"spell", timing:"action", effect:create-token Mech} with NO cost and not type "activated" — the Disempower/[1]/[Exhaust] cost was dropped by the parser, so the engine never exposes it as an activatable ability. No Mech token could ever be produced.

history.note: already fixed: parser accepts 'Disempower this/it' leading cost; ven-087-166 activated ability #1 parses + activates
